requests.intent: One persistent module-local shell owns breadcrumbs, identity, lifecycle/context continuity and Operate/Settings/Diagnostics composition.
requests.boundary: Do not hard-code module-kind routes or create a second continuity owner.

requests.intent: Keep the private Setup conversation separate from Execute and hand off a context draft explicitly.
requests.boundary: Do not merge Setup history into Execute, activate context implicitly, or expose secrets/permissions.

requests.intent: Review a versioned context draft and apply explicitly while retaining the prior active version.
requests.boundary: Do not replace active context before Apply succeeds or synthesize readiness/permission.

requests.intent: Navigate multiple Execute sessions while preserving selection across compact transformation.
requests.boundary: Do not include private Setup or let the rail own workflow completion.

requests.intent: Keep a persistent Execute conversation, composer and typed inline widgets beside the kind workbench.
requests.boundary: Do not execute arbitrary markup/scripts or let widget payloads mutate shell ownership.

requests.intent: Resolve a kind workbench from a registry without branching the shared shell per module kind.
requests.boundary: Do not move kind semantics into Grammar or replace chat on non-compact layouts.
